activities.activity_description: Implement and verify the ability to easily deploy a Spark streaming module developed using Scala, ensuring compatibility with the existing deployment pipeline.
Update the project wiki to add a 'Troubleshooting' section with the recommended ulimit setting of 10K to prevent 'Too many open files' errors.
Modify the xd-container-logger.properties file to include the 'date' in the log output format to aid in troubleshooting issues on specific days and times.
Refactor Kafka tests to run the Kafka Server as a separate running process to improve the build experience and isolate test environments.
Update the publish-maven.gradle script to automatically pull dependency versions (e.g., Spring Boot, hadoop-common) from the central dependencies.properties file.
Modify Kafka tests to support running on an external broker, reducing the footprint of the build process.
Review current Sonar violations, fix the relevant ones, and mark the irrelevant ones as invalid in the SonarQube dashboard.
Build a Spark batch job sample to demonstrate distributed data computation capabilities.
Perform final integration of all changes, run the complete build suite, and verify that all user stories are met without regressions.
